tools.name: request_withdrawal_challenge
tools.description: Start a signed withdrawal request. This temporarily stores the public key and creates a ten-minute, single-use challenge. It does not remove the existing participation record. Never send a private key.

tools.name: complete_signed_withdrawal
tools.description: Complete withdrawal with an Ed25519 signature made locally by the same key used to enroll. This removes the active register record and outstanding challenges for that key. Hosting backups and operational logs may have separate retention. Never send a private key.
